answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital, creating a dense grove of economic security. Unlike systems that attempt to forge influence through cheap compute, this model forces participants to lock assets, which are as rare as quartz in a liquid market. An attacker faces prohibitive costs, as acquiring sufficient stake to hijack consensus requires purchasing enough tokens to collapse the very value they intend to corrupt, rendering the attack irrational.
